notes:
Describes work, positions, or leave periods for which no salary or pay is given. Common in discussions of employment, internships, volunteer work, and leave policies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無給|むきゅう}{休暇|きゅうか}: unpaid leave
- {無給|むきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦インターン→インターン：24404_intaan⟧: unpaid intern
- {無給|むきゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work without pay
- {無給|むきゅう}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: unpaid period
- {無給|むきゅう}⟦{労働|ろうどう}→労働：03785_roudou⟧: unpaid labor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{有給|ゆうきゅう}→有給：04552_yuukyuu⟧: paid — the antonym; most commonly seen in ⟦{有給|ゆうきゅう}{休暇|きゅうか}→有給休暇：06996_yuukyuukyuuka⟧ (paid leave)
- {無償|むしょう}: free of charge, gratuitous — broader; can apply to goods and services, not just labor
- {無報酬|むほうしゅう}: without remuneration — more formal; emphasizes the absence of any reward

NOTE ON HOMOPHONE:
Not to be confused with ⟦{無休|むきゅう}→無休：10998_mukyuu⟧ (no days off, always open), which has the same reading but different meaning and kanji.

definitions.explanation: receiving no pay or salary for work or a position; without monetary compensation
